_: Your laws. The station measures, you decide. Edit this file and press R.
_quantities: order          poles carrying signal, 2 per conjugate section
crown_db       tallest point above the frame's own median
dip_db         deepest point below the frame's own median
tilt_db        low band minus high band, positive means it falls
peaks          local maxima above 4 dB prominence
gap_oct        smallest gap between neighbouring poles, octaves
zero_min_st    zero nearest its own pole, semitones
zero_max_st    zero furthest from its own pole, semitones
scale_spread_db  loudest section level minus quietest
meet_st        closest any two poles pass across the wheel
meet_at        where on the wheel that happens, 0..1

laws.why: every section carrying a conjugate pair
corpus median 69.8, deep notches are the mechanism
under 3 st two poles fuse and arrive hot
something should meet, or the wheel is a crossfade
